description.value:
You target one humanoid you can see within range, who must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. On each of its turns, the charmed target must use its action, before moving, to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally designate; if you designate no target or none is within its reach, it may act normally.

You must use your action on each of your subsequent turns to sustain this control, or the power ends. The target may also attempt a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the power on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
